events.reported_impact: Israel launched a large-scale air campaign. Strikes hit Natanz nuclear enrichment facility, destroying above-ground sections. Significant damage to air defenses and missile sites reported.
As part of a large-scale air campaign, military and infrastructure targets were hit. Senior nuclear scientists and IRGC commanders were targeted.
Israel attacked the IRGC's largest missile site in Khorramabad, targeting ballistic missile capabilities.
Explosions heard across Tehran, with air defense systems activated to intercept Israeli strikes. 78 people killed, over 320 wounded, mostly civilians, according to Iran's UN ambassador.
Explosions reported in Qom. Part of wider strikes where 78 people were killed and over 320 wounded.
A radar site near Tabriz was targeted. Part of wider strikes where 78 people were killed and over 320 wounded.
Iran launched over 100 missiles and drones. Most were intercepted, but some caused critical injuries (two people), moderate injuries (eight), and slight injuries (34) from shrapnel.
Iran launched over 100 missiles and drones. Most were intercepted, but some caused critical injuries and shrapnel wounds.

events.location_description: South Pars Gas Field, Bushehr Province
events.reported_impact: Israeli drones struck the South Pars Gas Field, causing a blaze that was later extinguished. The scale of disruption remains unclear.

events.location_description: Shahran oil depot, northwest of Tehran
events.reported_impact: Israeli strike caused a fire at the Shahran oil depot. The depot holds about 8 million liters of gasoline daily, threatening significant damage to nearby residential areas.
Four people, including women and children, were killed in Bat Yam, south of Tel Aviv, with scores more wounded due to a blast damaging a multistory building.
Iranian missiles struck northern Israel, killing three people and wounding 13.
Iran launched a new wave of drone and missile attacks targeting Haifa and Tel Aviv. No specific casualty or damage details reported.
Israeli strikes hit an oil refinery in southern Tehran, causing heavy smoke and fire.
Iranian missile strike hit the Bazan oil refinery in Haifa, killing three people.

Iranian missile barrage caused significant casualties in Rehovot, with debris, bloodstained bandages, and shattered glass reported. At least 24 people killed, 380 wounded in wider attacks across Israel on this day.
Israeli air force conducted strikes on storage and missile launch infrastructure sites in western Iran. At least 224 people killed, 1,481 wounded in wider attacks across Iran on this day.
Iran launched missiles targeting Tel Aviv. Three people killed, over 70 injured (one in serious condition, five in moderate condition). Damage reported to two buildings in Tel Aviv.
Israeli strike hit Iranian state TV headquarters, causing black smoke to billow.
Iranian missile struck a residential building, killing three people and causing property damage.
Two Iranian drones intercepted over the Golan Heights, heading from southern Syria. No casualties or damage reported.
Israeli strikes hit underground infrastructure at Natanz, likely damaging or destroying thousands of centrifuges. No radiation increase reported.
Iranian missile barrage hit the Weizmann Institute, causing unprecedented casualties and massive destruction.
Hit centrifuge manufacturing workshop, no casualties reported.
Targeted military installation, no details on impacts.
Saeed Izadi killed.
Israeli drone strike killed three civilians near Montazeri hospital.
Israeli airstrike killed seven IRGC members and two conscripts.
U.S. airstrikes with bunker-busting bombs targeted the underground nuclear enrichment site. Facilities 'obliterated'.

events.location_description: Fordow Fuel Enrichment Facility, near Qom
events.reported_impact: U.S. airstrikes caused limited damage to Fordow enrichment site, setting back Iran's nuclear capability by a few months.
Significant damage and several casualties from Iranian missile strikes.

In Operation True Promise I—Iran's first-ever direct attack on Israel from Iranian territory (~170 drones, ~30 cruise missiles, ~120 ballistic missiles)—four ballistic missiles impacted Nevatim Airbase, causing minor structural damage near a C-130 transport aircraft and an unused runway.
Heavy shrapnel from an intercepted Iranian ballistic missile fell on a Bedouin home near Arad in the Negev desert during Operation True Promise I, critically injuring a 7-year-old girl.
Iranian ballistic missiles targeted Ramon Airbase in the Negev desert during the April 14 barrage, with minor ground impacts reported in open areas.

In retaliation for Operation True Promise I, Israeli Air Force warplanes fired stand-off missiles that destroyed the 30N6E2 Tomb Stone engagement radar of an Iranian S-300PMU2 air-defense battery at the 8th Shekari Air Base protecting Isfahan's nuclear complex, confirmed by SAR satellite imagery.

events.location_description: Saadat Abad / Neshat Compound, Northern Tehran
events.reported_impact: An Israeli covert kinetic operation struck an IRGC-protected veterans' guesthouse in northern Tehran hours after the Iranian presidential inauguration, killing Hamas political chief Ismail Haniyeh and his bodyguard and directly triggering Iran's October 2024 retaliation.

During Operation True Promise II (~180–200 ballistic missiles launched from Iran), between 20 and 32 missiles penetrated air defenses and struck Nevatim Airbase, damaging an aircraft hangar roof, taxiways, and support buildings as confirmed by satellite imagery.
Iranian ballistic missiles impacted inside the perimeter of Tel Nof Airbase south of Tel Aviv during Operation True Promise II, triggering secondary explosions.

events.location_description: Hod HaSharon & Glilot (North of Tel Aviv)
events.reported_impact: Iranian ballistic missiles targeting the Mossad headquarters and Unit 8200 intelligence complex at Camp Glilot impacted nearby Hod HaSharon and excavated a deep crater near the Glilot complex, damaging over 100 residential homes.

An Iranian ballistic missile warhead directly struck the Shalhevet elementary school in Gedera during the October 1 barrage, heavily damaging the building with no casualties as students were not present.

events.location_description: Parchin & Khojir Military Complexes, Tehran Province
events.reported_impact: During Operation Days of Repentance, over 100 IAF aircraft struck the Taleghan 2 nuclear weapons research building at Parchin and solid-propellant ballistic missile planetary mixers at Khojir, destroying Iran's remaining S-300 batteries and killing 4 air-defense soldiers and 1 civilian guard (UCDP GED v26.1 ID #550232).
Israeli airstrikes hit the IRGC Aerospace Force solid-fuel rocket motor production facility at the Shahrud Space Center in Semnan Province, confirmed by satellite imagery.

In the opening wave of Operation Days of Repentance, Israeli warplanes struck early-warning radars and air-defense batteries in Khuzestan Province (near Abadan refinery and Bandar-e Mahshahr petrochemical complex) and Ilam Province.
Two IRGC members were killed in Khorramabad while clearing unexploded Israeli munitions remaining from the June 2025 Twelve-Day War (UCDP GED v26.1 ID #590534).

Opening decapitation strike of Operation Roaring Lion / Operation Epic Fury hit the Supreme Leader's residential compound, Presidential Office, and Supreme National Security Council in Pasteur district, killing Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, IRGC commander Mohammad Pakpour, and 33 top officials/guards (UCDP ID #620877).

Joint US-Israeli strikes targeted air defense batteries (HQ-9B/S-300), command-and-control nodes, and military airfields across Tehran including Mehrabad, University Street, Jomhouri, and Seyed Khandan.

Strikes targeting the IRGC Navy Asif Brigade headquarters at the Sayyid al-Shuhada complex hit the adjacent Shajareh Tayyebeh girls' elementary school in Minab, resulting in 157 confirmed civilian fatalities (UCDP ID #620876).

In Iran's opening retaliatory barrage (~150 ballistic missiles and dozens of drones), a ballistic missile struck a residential block in Tel Aviv before sirens sounded, killing one woman and injuring 27 others (UCDP ID #620910).
Iranian ballistic missiles and drones targeted Haifa during the opening retaliatory salvos, triggering multi-layered air defense interceptions and impact alerts across Haifa Bay.

Israeli and US airstrikes hit security headquarters, the Tehran Revolutionary Court, state radio/TV buildings, and military sites near Azadi Stadium and Milad Tower. Intelligence officials Mohammad Baseri and Gholamreza Rezaian were killed.

An Iranian ballistic missile evaded two Arrow/David's Sling interceptors and scored a direct hit on a communal synagogue bomb shelter in Beit Shemesh, killing 9 civilians and injuring 65 in the deadliest single strike on Israel during the war (UCDP ID #624994).
An Iranian ballistic missile impacted a roadway in West Jerusalem late in the day, destroying civilian vehicles, damaging nearby property, and wounding 6 people.
Airstrikes bombed and damaged the entrance buildings and surface infrastructure at the Natanz uranium enrichment complex, confirmed by IAEA satellite imagery analysis.
Strikes hit the Iranian Navy's home port facilities at Shahid Bahonar Pier in Bandar Abbas, setting naval vessels and dock infrastructure ablaze.
An Iranian ballistic missile struck a residential neighborhood in Beersheba, injuring 19 civilians and damaging buildings and vehicles.

Precision airstrikes hit Bushehr Airport (12 km from Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant), destroying an Iran Air Airbus A319 on the tarmac and heavily damaging the terminal, prompting Rosatom to evacuate staff.

events.location_description: Imam Hossein University & SNSC HQ, Tehran
events.reported_impact: IDF airstrikes destroyed the Supreme National Security Council (SNSC) headquarters, Expediency Discernment Council building, and IRGC-affiliated Imam Hossein University in Tehran. Nearby blasts also damaged Golestan Palace.
Iranian ballistic missile strikes and falling interceptor shrapnel impacted Bnei Brak, Rosh HaAyin, and Tel Aviv, injuring 8 civilians.
IDF airstrikes hit an underground ballistic missile complex in Tehran, the District 18 municipality building, and military compounds in Mahallati town (northeastern Tehran).
Early morning Iranian ballistic missile barrage triggered air-raid sirens across Tel Aviv and central Israel; intercepted missile debris ignited fires in central Israel with no fatalities reported.

Overnight Israeli airstrikes struck five major oil storage and refining facilities in and near Tehran and Karaj for the first time in the 2026 war, along with the IRGC Aerospace HQ and 50 ammo shelters, killing 4 people and blanketing Tehran in black smoke (UCDP ID #625187).

events.location_description: Yehud, Bat Yam, Holon & Or Yehuda
events.reported_impact: An Iranian ballistic missile carrying a cluster bomb warhead dispersed submunitions across Yehud, Or Yehuda, Holon, and Bat Yam, killing two construction workers in Yehud and seriously injuring a third (UCDP ID #625254).
Iran launched ballistic missiles and drones targeting IDF strategic installations including Palmachim Airbase and Shin Bet headquarters in central Israel.
Iranian missile barrage targeted Ovda Airbase in southern Israel as part of coordinated strikes against Israeli air force infrastructure.
Joint airstrikes hit military and oil terminal defenses on Kharg Island, Iran's primary crude oil export hub in the Persian Gulf.
Iranian missile fragments struck the southern port city of Eilat following air defense interceptions, seriously injuring a child and lightly injuring a man.
Heavy US-Israeli airstrikes hit defense industrial and military targets in Isfahan (killing 15 people) alongside 20 explosions recorded near Shiraz and southern Tehran.

Missile and interceptor debris from an Iranian attack targeting Jerusalem fell inside the Old City near the Temple Mount/Al-Aqsa Mosque, Church of the Holy Sepulchre, and Jewish Quarter, causing structural damage but no casualties.

An Iranian ballistic missile carrying a cluster warhead hit a residential building in Ramat Gan (killing two residents in their 70s) and damaged platforms at the Tel Aviv-Savidor Center railway station. The IRGC claimed the strike was retaliation for the killing of Ali Larijani (UCDP ID #626948).

events.location_description: South Pars Gas Field, Asaluyeh, Bushehr Province
events.reported_impact: Israeli airstrikes hit natural gas refineries and processing facilities at Asaluyeh (South Pars gas field), causing major fires and disrupting gas infrastructure.

Iranian cluster munition missile barrage damaged three empty private aircraft parked at Ben Gurion Airport (forcing passenger caps on outbound flights) and killed a Thai agricultural worker at nearby Moshav Adanim in the Sharon region (UCDP ID #624788).
During a day of 14 Iranian missile salvos toward Israel, a ballistic missile struck the BAZAN Group oil refinery complex in Haifa Bay, damaging essential refining infrastructure.

Iran launched 9 ballistic missile salvos (including cluster munition warheads) toward Jerusalem and central Israel, damaging homes in Rehovot and dropping interceptor debris 400m from the Western Wall in Jerusalem.
Heavy bunker-buster bomb strike targeted underground nuclear facilities at Natanz, triggering Iranian retaliatory strikes against the Negev nuclear research area.

Claiming to target the Shimon Peres Negev Nuclear Research Center in retaliation for strikes on Natanz, an Iranian ballistic missile collapsed a residential building in Dimona, injuring 64 people (including one child critically).
An Iranian ballistic missile struck a residential area in the southern town of Arad during the Negev barrage, wounding up to 115 people (including 10 seriously injured).
Iranian missile fragments struck and damaged a kindergarten building in Tel Aviv during morning salvos.

During 14 Iranian missile salvos fired at Israel (targeting Haifa, Tel Aviv, Dimona, and Eilat), submunitions and warhead shrapnel struck residential houses in Nesher near Haifa, injuring several civilians.
An Iranian ballistic missile struck the moshav of Eshtaol near Beit Shemesh in the Jerusalem hills, injuring 19 people and damaging several homes.
An Iranian cluster munition missile attack struck a residential building in Tel Aviv (the same block hit on Feb 28), killing a security guard on duty and wounding two others (UCDP ID #626990).
Debris from an intercepted Iranian ballistic missile struck the BAZAN oil refinery in Haifa, hitting a fuel tanker and damaging a facility roof during a day of 7 missile salvos.

events.location_description: Bnei Brak, Ramat Gan & Petah Tikva
events.reported_impact: Three Iranian ballistic missile volleys dispersed cluster bomb submunitions across Bnei Brak, Ramat Gan, and Petah Tikva, damaging buildings and injuring 8 civilians.

An Iranian cluster munition missile scattered bomblets across a dense residential neighborhood in Bnei Brak during 6 missile salvos, wounding 14 civilians including an 11-year-old girl who later succumbed to her injuries.
An Iranian ballistic missile strike directly hit and damaged an Israeli defense drone manufacturing facility in Petah Tikva.

events.location_description: B1 Bileghan Bridge, Karaj, Alborz Province
events.reported_impact: US-Israeli airstrikes hit the B1 Bileghan transit bridge connecting Tehran and Karaj (assessed by ISW as a logistics route for missile components), killing 13 people and wounding 95 (UCDP ID #625373).

events.location_description: HaKirya Military HQ, Tel Aviv & Bnei Brak
events.reported_impact: Fragments and cluster submunitions from an Iranian ballistic missile barrage hit in the immediate vicinity of the IDF's HaKirya military headquarters in central Tel Aviv and damaged buildings in Bnei Brak and Ramat Gan.
An Iranian ballistic missile directly struck a residential building in Haifa days before the April 8 ceasefire, killing 5 civilians and injuring dozens (UCDP ID #628589).

Breaking the April 2026 ceasefire in response to IDF strikes in Beirut, the IRGC launched ballistic missiles targeting Israel's Ramat David Airbase. IDF air defenses intercepted the incoming missiles with no casualties reported.
In retaliation for Iran's June 7 missile launch, Israeli airstrikes struck targets across Iran and partially damaged the Karun petrochemical complex in Mahshahr, Khuzestan Province.
Israeli Air Force warplanes conducted retaliatory strikes against military and air defense installations in Tehran, Isfahan, and Tabriz, killing two Iranian military personnel (UCDP ID #635421).

Following Israeli strikes on Tehran, Tabriz, Isfahan, and Mahshahr, the IRGC launched a second wave of ballistic missiles targeting Tel Nof Airbase and central Israel, triggering air-raid sirens across Jerusalem and the center.
IRGC ballistic missiles targeted Nevatim Airbase in southern Israel as part of the June 8 reciprocal strike exchange before both sides halted fire under US diplomatic pressure.

An Iranian ballistic missile launched toward the southern corridor near Eilat/Aqaba was intercepted by Israeli Iron Dome and US Aegis missile defense systems, with fragments impacting north of Eilat. IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir warned of direct counterattacks against Iran.
